mcpHint: Use tools from connected servers in conversations.
marketHint: Find DSH plugins by name and inspect their sources. Manage Aura plugin directories under Plugins.
voiceHint: SenseVoice transcribes speech on the device running Aura and inserts the text into your draft.
agentTeamHint: Allow conversations to create named teammates and shared tasks.
sessionSearchHint: Search the text of saved conversations in the current workspace.
voiceDownloadHint: Initial setup downloads about 239 MB of model data plus supporting files.
invalidArguments: Arguments must be a JSON array of strings.
invalidEnvironment: Environment mapping must be a JSON object whose values are backend environment variable names.
trustedServerHint: Use trusted servers. STDIO runs commands on the device hosting Aura. Reuse a name to update a server.
